effective_scope: Subsequent hosted campaigns; no original registration, receipt, workflow outcome or performance rule is changed.

experiments.name: Full-image three-slot performance repeats
experiments.reason: Linux establishes no repeatable physical gain. Both Windows matched workloads are adverse: Wave512 three-slot rates are about 9.1 steps/s versus 13.6–13.8 for two slots, and maxima are about 701–709 ms versus 248–249 ms. The large Windows three-slot arms also have lower rates and more >500 ms physical gaps. No source evidence links the subsequent native storage certificate to a repair of texture reuse or renderer backpressure.
experiments.selection: Retained negative diagnostic control; ordinary and evaluator default remains Full2.
preserved_gates: All two/three-slot exact GPU current/previous history, ownership, rotation and allocation checks
Production Main World replacement, publisher refusal and exact fallback recovery
Original raw source/slot arms, failed workflow and detached corrected extent replay
Full2 ordinary source ABBA, sustained, mixed, deadline and same-engine render-owner qualification
experiments.independent_review: Performance qualification lane agreed that retiming a rejected nondefault arm after an unrelated native change is not an acceptance requirement.
experiments.reopen_only_for: A distinct causal renderer/publication repair or an explicit physical-driver question. Any reopened experiment requires a new prospective record and retains these negatives.
